rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese choice for a self-contained flat, especially when discussing renting or buying one.

example.english: This apartment has two bedrooms, just right for our family.
example.traditional: 呢個單位有兩間房，啱晒我哋一家人住。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan1 wai2 jau5 loeng5 gaan1 fong2 ngaam1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zyu6

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring to an apartment as a type of residence rather than using the everyday Hong Kong term 單位.

example.english: This type of apartment usually has shared facilities.
example.traditional: 呢類公寓通常設有共用設施。
example.jyutping: ni1 leoi6 gung1 jyu6 tung1 soeng4 cit3 jau5 gung6 jung6 cit3 si1
